# Darrshan Govender

> Industrial AI engineer and founder of Agulhas Code in Durban, South Africa: predictive maintenance, cited procedure assistants and human-supervised agents for heavy industry, each published with how it was tested and where it falls short.

Title: Industrial AI engineer; Founder, Agulhas Code
Location: Durban, South Africa (UTC+2)
Availability: contract and fractional work
Licence of the code described here: MIT
Data note: the industrial systems below use synthetic data or simulated models, and each repository says so.

## Pages
- [Home](https://darrshangovender.github.io/): what he builds, with results, architecture diagrams and interactive replays driven by the repositories' own output.
- [About](https://darrshangovender.github.io/about/): who he is, where he works from and how Agulhas Code relates to the repositories published under his name.

## Flagship projects (public GitHub repositories, Python, MIT)
- [asset-health](https://github.com/darrshangovender/asset-health): Offline predictive maintenance for mining assets, scored one failure at a time: anomaly detection, remaining useful life as an interval, cost-aware alerts and structured work orders, on a seeded synthetic fleet.
- [plant-copilot](https://github.com/darrshangovender/plant-copilot): Bilingual Arabic and English assistant for plant procedures: answers only from controlled documents, cites the clause and revision, applies access control before retrieval and refuses when the documents are silent. Synthetic corpus.
- [maintenance-agent](https://github.com/darrshangovender/maintenance-agent): Supervised maintenance-planning agent: drafts a work order from an alert, checks it with a 16-rule verifier that uses no model, and stops at a human approval gate. All data is synthetic.
- [guardrail](https://github.com/darrshangovender/guardrail): Safety gateway for model inputs and outputs: prompt-injection detection, PII redaction, groundedness checks and structured-output repair behind one policy layer.
- [mcp-gateway](https://github.com/darrshangovender/mcp-gateway): Hardened MCP server framework: API-key auth, tenant isolation, per-tool guardrails, rate limits and an audit log, serving the 2026-07-28 MCP revision and the 2025 revisions side by side.

## Research harness (public GitHub repositories)
- [closed-loop](https://github.com/darrshangovender/closed-loop): Research harness (v0.1): a maintenance stack run as one loop on a simulated plant, attacked on held-out seeds under a pre-registration, with losses published at the same size as wins. All data is synthetic.
- [closed-loop-v2](https://github.com/darrshangovender/closed-loop-v2): Research harness (v0.2): a pre-registered test of whether conformal remaining-life coverage survives a replacement policy, on NASA C-MAPSS turbofan trajectories, which are simulated, not field data.
